response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr GROUP BY cr.raceId), avg_e AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS avg_entries FROM per_race) SELECT pr.raceId, c.country, COALESCE(pr.total_points, 0) AS total_constructor_points, pr.entries, pr.entries - a.avg_entries AS diff_from_avg FROM per_race pr CROSS JOIN avg_e a JOIN races r ON r.raceId = pr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE pr.entries > a.avg_entries ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average number of entries per race is computed over races that have at least one constructorResults row (races with no entries are not counted in the average).
Entries means rows in constructorResults; total points is the SUM of constructorResults.points, with NULL points ignored (shown as 0 if all are NULL).
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

alternatives.interpretation: Average computed over all races in the races table, so races with no constructor result entries count as 0 entries.
